issues.on_page: Emergency 911 Fund Taxes 20,119; 911 Wireless Service Fund Taxes 47,440
issues.issue: Leaving these unlabeled is defensible because neither fund name says 'surcharge' and there is no 911 tax category. However, the relaxed fund-name rule lists '911 Surcharge fund' as an example of a fund that identifies its tax, so a person may want to give these 67,559 their own tax type (other taxes). The same 67,559 is inside receipts[3], 4,780,011.
